info.title: OmniCourse API
info.description: REST API of OmniCourse: degree audit, curriculum and roadmap planning.

acceptedTerms.description: Consent to the terms and the privacy notice. Must be true.

accountRestored.description: True when this sign-in cancelled a pending account deletion; tell the student.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

tables.description: Every row this user owns (user_id), by table name, without credentials.

password.description: The current password, asked again before deleting.

purgeAfter.description: Signing in before this time cancels the deletion.

year.description: First calendar year of the academic year: 2026 means 2026–2027.

number.description: Term of the academic year: 1, 2 or 3. Whether 3 is a main or a summer term depends on the program (APCS: main, QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 6.4b).

result.description: graded: the grade is set. in_progress (UC-02 A3), exempt, pass, fail: no grade.

grade.description: 10-point scale, one decimal. Required when result is graded; null otherwise.

rows.description: The whole transcript, at most 300 rows. A retaken course has one row per attempt.

url.description: The direct link: the deepest page the school allows

account.description: The account that signs in to the portal

keywords.description: Words the search matches besides the title

lastCheckedOn.description: The day a team member last followed the guide on the real portal

outOfDate.description: Last checked more than 6 months ago, counted in Vietnam dates (UC-10 A5)

texts.description: Only the languages the guide is published in (UC-10 A8)

label.example: Thông báo của Phòng Đào tạo

url.description: An https address, or an OmniCourse path starting with /

announcement.description: The school's announcement with this term's dates

kind.description: regulation: a clause, with document, clause and url. team: the team's experience.

url.description: The direct link: the deepest page the school allows

account.description: The account that signs in to the portal

purpose.description: What the student does on this site

keywords.description: Words the search matches besides the title

lastCheckedOn.description: The day a team member last followed the guide on the real portal

outOfDate.description: Last checked more than 6 months ago, counted in Vietnam dates (UC-10 A5)

portals.description: G01 only: every portal the other guides use

texts.description: Only the languages the guide is published in (UC-10 A8)

nameVi.example: Cử nhân ngành Khoa học máy tính - Chương trình Tiên tiến

faculty.description: The faculty that owns the program

trainingType.description: Training type (QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 6.4, 7.2; ADR 0012): advanced = Tiên tiến, joint = Liên kết, high_quality = Chất lượng cao, standard = đại trà. It sets the terms and the credit caps. null: not recorded.

cohortYears.description: The cohorts that have a curriculum, oldest first

nameVi.example: Cử nhân ngành Khoa học máy tính - Chương trình Tiên tiến

faculty.description: The faculty that owns the program

trainingType.description: Training type (QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 6.4, 7.2; ADR 0012): advanced = Tiên tiến, joint = Liên kết, high_quality = Chất lượng cao, standard = đại trà. It sets the terms and the credit caps. null: not recorded.

theoryPeriods.description: Theory periods ("LT"); null where the official table leaves the cell blank

name.description: The heading as printed in the official curriculum

kind.description: compulsory: every course must be passed. elective: the student chooses courses up to creditsTotalMin.

creditsTotalMin.description: Minimum credits of an elective group. null when the printed rule is not a minimum on this group alone; officialNotes then states it.

officialNotes.description: The printed rule text, for rules the columns cannot express

courses.description: The courses linked to the group, by code

cohortYear.description: The year the cohort entered the program

totalCreditsMin.description: Credits the cohort needs to graduate, as printed

requirementGroups.description: Every requirement group, by name (the schema stores no printed order). A course may sit in several groups.

theoryPeriods.description: Theory periods ("LT"); null where the official table leaves the cell blank

memberships.description: By program code, cohort year, then group name

program.description: Program code. Only the programs offered in this release; null until the student picks one (UC-01 A7).

cohort.description: Cohort: the year the student entered the program. Offered: APCS 2024, 2025. Set together with program, and null together with it.

targetGraduationTerm.description: Target graduation term, from the current term up to 8 academic years ahead; null when not set.

creditsPerTerm.description: Credits the student wants to take per term, a whole number of 1 or more; null when not set. Stored as asked: the rule engine applies the credit cap when it builds a plan.

internshipTerm.description: Internship term, in the same range as targetGraduationTerm; "none" when none is planned; null when not set.

finished.description: The student pressed Finish (UC-01 step 9): onboarding then opens no more. Needs a program and cohort. False while onboarding is unfinished, so it resumes at the first unanswered step (UC-01 A8).

accumulated.description: Credits of every passed course of the curriculum, GDTC and GDQP-AN included (Điều 11.4)

towardTotal.description: Passed credits toward the cohort total

yearLevel.description: Year of study from the accumulated credits (Điều 15.3)

average.description: Điểm trung bình (Điều 15.1.a): every course studied, by its official grade, 10-point scale

accumulatedAverage.description: Điểm trung bình tích lũy (Điều 15.1.b): passed courses only, 10-point scale

accumulatedAverageFourPoint.description: accumulatedAverage on the 4-point scale; reference only (Điều 11.2)

petition.description: The petition route; a violation never blocks

kind.description: null when the training type is not recorded

credits.description: Every course of the term, retakes included (Điều 7.1.b)

cumulativeAccumulatedAverage.description: Điểm trung bình tích lũy from the start to the end of this term

countsTowardTotal.description: false: required, but outside the cohort total (GDTC, GDQP-AN)

countsTowardGpa.description: false: left out of the GPA (QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 15.1.c)

status.description: counted_in_other_group: the course is passed or in progress but counts in another group (a course counts once, ADR 0013)

result.description: The official attempt: the last completed one (Điều 14)

requiredCredits.description: null: the group has no minimum of its own (see combinedMinimums)

passedCredits.description: Passed credits counted here toward the cohort total

overflowInCredits.description: Credits another group's excess brings here

overflowOutCredits.description: Passed credits beyond requiredCredits, counted toward overflowToGroupId

remainingCredits.description: requiredCredits − passed − overflowIn − inProgress, at least 0

met.description: Compulsory: every course passed. Elective: passed + overflowIn ≥ requiredCredits; true without one.

courses.description: Every course of the group, by code

groupIds.description: Ids of the requirement groups it adds up

credits.description: Passed credits of the groups together, overflow from outside them included

status.description: done: every condition the data can check is met; the notChecked ones still need the school

unmatchedCourses.description: Transcript courses no group lists; they count toward nothing

curriculum.description: The curriculum the plan is made against; it stays the same when the student changes program or cohort.

updatedAt.description: Last rename or change of placements.

kind.description: course: a course of the catalog. slot: credits held for a requirement group, no course chosen yet.

courseCode.description: A catalog course code, exactly as stored. Set for a course, null for a slot.

requirementGroupId.description: A requirement group of the plan's curriculum. Set for a slot, null for a course.

credits.description: The slot's credits. Null for a course, whose credits are the catalog's.

placements.description: In order, at most 30. A term with nothing placed is left out.

programCode.description: The program of the curriculum the plan is made against.

terms.description: One entry per term, each term once, at most 30 terms and 300 placements in all; a course is placed once. Prerequisites, offering terms and credit caps are not checked here: the rule engine reports them as issues. Left out: an empty plan.

curriculum.description: The curriculum the plan is made against; it stays the same when the student changes program or cohort.

updatedAt.description: Last rename or change of placements.

terms.description: Terms oldest first, placements in order. A body to PUT back as it is.

name.description: The copy's name. Left out: the original's name; the UI words any "copy of".

terms.description: One entry per term, each term once, at most 30 terms and 300 placements in all; a course is placed once. Prerequisites, offering terms and credit caps are not checked here: the rule engine reports them as issues.
